question: What prior limitation of speech may be overcome by this meditation practice?
premises: Even a deceitful or dull person is included
Such a person may be unable to speak clearly
The inability concerns clear words and syllables
inference: Even one previously unable to speak a clear word or syllable can be transformed by the practice.
uncertainties: The term śaṭha may imply dullness or deceit depending on context
plain_english: Even one who is dull and unable to speak a clear word or syllable.
